_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, operate-debug-log-and-monitoring (board BqAppWerking). One app-health-sample per page per five-minute batch of a running built app: counts only, never a user, a path, a body or a message (REQ-BQDM-004). Written by AppHealthService with the app and version the server derived, read back by AppHealthService::computeHealth() for the app detail page, deleted after 30 days by AppHealthSampleCleanup. Samples are append-only, so two browsers never overwrite each other. The register version in openbuild_register.json is bumped so the import runs.

AppHealthSample.title: App health sample
AppHealthSample.description: Counts one browser reported for one page of a running built app during one five-minute window.
AppHealthSample.x-openregister-demo-data: Written by running apps. A generated sample reads as traffic nobody made.
